question: Should the remaining work be a Signal-specific transport-safe hidden-body or attachment-only fix, or should OpenClaw add a cross-channel `messages` media-placeholder suppression setting?
rationale: Current main already fixed iMessage locally, while Signal still appears to need a non-empty transport body and any new global `messages` option is a product/config-surface decision under repository policy.

options.title: Prefer Signal-specific fix
options.body: Keep default behavior compatible and repair the remaining Signal visible-caption path with focused transport proof before adding global config.

options.title: Add global messages setting
options.body: Introduce a documented default-off suppression option with schema, metadata/help/docs, and cross-channel tests if maintainers want user policy control.

options.title: Defer pending live proof
options.body: Keep the issue open until a contributor supplies live Signal proof showing which transport-safe replacement works best.

recommendation.title: Prefer Signal-specific fix
recommendation.body: Keep default behavior compatible and repair the remaining Signal visible-caption path with focused transport proof before adding global config.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced Signal provider support and already reviewed this issue as the canonical config/product request.
